name: Screen Share Indicator
author: alkin
description: A chip next to the clock while Chrome is sharing your screen, a window or a tab.

barWidget.description: Shows what Chrome is sharing (screen, window or tab) and which site is sharing it. Click to jump to it.

schema.label: Show label
schema.description: Show Screen / Window / Tab next to the icon.

schema.label: Detect without the Chrome extension
schema.description: Use PipeWire to detect screen and window shares when the optional extension is not installed.

schema.label: Picker preview delay (ms)
schema.description: PipeWire mode only: ignore streams shorter than this, which hides Chrome's picker preview.
